_implementation_notes: Map 17: S.S. Anne main deck (dining hall / lounge).
Map 28: S.S. Anne cabin deck A (passenger cabins).
Map 29: S.S. Anne cabin deck B (kitchen / restaurant).
STORY: The S.S. Anne is reworked as a League diplomatic
event. Gym Leaders, officials, and well-connected trainers
gather to discuss the growing Rocket crisis. The player
walks through a political party atmosphere.
Key characters: Lt. Surge (military hardliner), Erika
Trainers are wealthy, connected, opinionated attendees.
MECHANICAL events preserved: All trade mechanics (EV004, EV005
choices/trade logic), fossil battle/choice (EV011), bed rest
(map 28 beds), waiter quest (map 29 full quest chain),
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP.
